description: Create a new host monitored via the openITCOCKPIT agent in Pull mode (openITCOCKPIT connects to the agent, rather than the agent pushing data). This is a two-step operation: it creates the host, then configures the agent connection for it. Does not auto-discover/create services from the agent - use list_installed_software etc. once the agent is reachable, and add services separately. hosttemplate_name must be visible from container_name's scope - use get_allowed_elements_for_container(object_type="host", container_name=...) to see which host templates qualify.
name: create_host_with_agent_pull_mode
title: Create Host (Agent Pull Mode)
